step0_classification.evidence: six nodes and six relations (E = N) form one shallow pipeline — CLI -> API gateway -> {Auth, Job queue -> Worker pool} -> Postgres — and the task asks for 'slow, sparse motion for traffic', the chain family's animated signature.
tie_breakers_considered: Density first: E=6, N=6 so E ~= N; no anti-parallel pair, no double-arrowhead redundant target, no bus between weakly-connected worlds — chain, not mesh, fabric or planes.
Depth is shallow (longest path cli->api->queue->worker->db = 5 ranks); nodes are six plain component names with no addresses, ports, AS numbers or qualifiers — not an identity-probe map.
Motion is a signature, not a tie-breaker: one dot per relation on a one-relation-per-node chain, with no phase-ordered wide fan — chain, not a lifecycle machine.
step0_classification.secondary_recipe: none required. api forks and Postgres merges, so the shipped view also keeps the mesh habit of co-viewing converging links as two distinct target-aligned ports (read and write land on separate Postgres ports), but the applied recipe is the chain's: short single-stage ranks, per-hop corridor room, one node per rank except the source's own fork.
